admission.justification: The maximum-entry and unavailable-state proof prevents an incomplete or first-entry-only ranking from presenting itself as the chosen measured sort.

applicability: The four numeric memory-fact sort options of the review page.
conditions: Aggregate maximum value over all entries, not only the first or changed entry.
An unavailable memory state makes all four options unavailable, displays its reason and applies Priority while preserving the requested preference.
A chunk with unavailable facts makes the merged memory state unavailable; do not sort a partially measured subset as if complete.
exclusions: Memory currentness, which ranks the shown state rather than a maximum numeric value.
Producing the backend values or converting unavailable values into zero.
